title: Waveform Playlist
summary: A multi-track audio editor and player for the web: canvas-based waveforms and drag-and-drop clip editing, as React components or Web Components.
why: Open-source multi-track audio editing in the browser, embeddable as components rather than a locked-in hosted app.

fingerprint.title: Multi-track Web Audio Editor | Waveform Playlist
fingerprint.description: A multi-track audio editor and player for the web — React components or framework-agnostic Web Components (Tone.js optional). Features canvas-based waveform visualization, drag-and-drop clip editing, and professional audio effects.
